other_access: PMC returned a browser challenge. arXiv:2112.11063 metadata was inspected but attempted v3 HTML returned 404; no theorem from that lead is used. The primary energy comparator was successfully retrieved in its exact v3 edition.
search_verdict: The energy and external-field methods are prior work. The bounded search did not establish a close physical wormhole predecessor to this specified inner estimate, and does not support priority or novelty acceptance.
development_notes: A time-refinement assertion failed in the first development evolution: subtracting occupied negative-energy populations from one amplified accumulated eigenvector/nonunitarity roundoff. At q=3, N=12 and duration 0.7, the 80/160/320-step work mismatches grew from 1.34e-10 to 5.46e-10.

The corrected calculation evolves the full one-particle matrix, uses positive particle/hole transition energies and a stable covariance difference for work, and uses the orthogonal divide-and-conquer eigensolver. The final 32/64/128-step checks pass, including independent DOP853 comparisons. The failure was numerical cancellation, not an observed failure of the energy theorem.
claim_limits: No local stress bound, interacting photon/graviton state, global compact-sector selection, higher-mode control, physical exterior or smooth quantum junction. Finite total energy is not a four-dimensional Hadamard statement.
contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping as primary and matched finite-duration transfer as fallback. For the defined free unequal-return LLL model, a prescribed noncommuting inner source admits a finite-energy causal quasifree state. The all-orders excitation-energy bound depends on amplitude and total time variation, not static holding time or a uniform spectral gap. The moving-load scaling gives E=O(log^6 q)=o(q delta). This is not a bound on local renormalized stress, the fluctuating gauge state or full exterior matching. CAR, external-field state construction and switching-time energy methods are established; no consequential physical novelty is accepted.
next_decisive_question: Construct the coupled fluctuating electric/rotational gauge and fermion state, retaining the full source-dependent exterior determinant and quadratic vertices; control local renormalized stress, higher modes and smooth semiclassical matching. The prescribed inner classical drive now has a separate cutoff-independent free-sea energy bound.
